mission.title: kubevirt: Allow configuration of alternative kubelet directories
mission.description: Allow configuration of alternative kubelet directories. Requested by 5+ users.

steps.title: Check current kubevirt deployment
steps.description:
Verify your kubevirt version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n kubevirt -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kubevirt
helm list -n kubevirt 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working kubevirt installation.

steps.title: Review kubevirt configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant kubevirt configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n kubevirt -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kubevirt
kubectl get configmap -n kubevirt -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=kubevirt
```
**Is this a BUG REPORT or FEATURE REQUEST?**: Feature Request

**What happened**:
I attempted to install KubeVirt and I couldn't because the distribution of Kubernetes I am using ([k0s](https://github.com/k0sproject/k0s)) uses a non-standard

steps.title: Apply the fix for Allow configuration of alternative kubelet directories
steps.description:
Threads the configured kubelet root through to the heartbeat controller:

virt-handler.go -> NewVirtualMachineController -> heartbeat.NewHeartBeat

Now `cpu_manager_state` is located relative to whatever `--kubelet-root` is actually set to.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n kubevirt -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kubevirt
kubectl get events -n kubevirt --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Allow configuration of alternative kubelet directories" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary:
Threads the configured kubelet root through to the heartbeat controller:

virt-handler.go -> NewVirtualMachineController -> heartbeat.NewHeartBeat

Now `cpu_manager_state` is located relative to whatever `--kubelet-root` is actually set to.
